canonical_project: NEWROC / South West Wireless Merredin Data Centre
owner: North Eastern Wheatbelt Regional Organisation of Councils / South West Wireless WA (Crisp Wireless)
notes: Official Shire of Merredin agenda described a BBRF-funded project to fabricate and install a data centre in Merredin plus 11 repeater stations across the NEWROC region; Shire of Bruce Rock minutes later stated the data centre at Merredin had already been built under the NEWROC project.
